messages:
Miriam: Free 34" curved monitor (3440x1440, 100Hz) + IKEA desk lamp. Leaving them at SF HQ, 4th floor Giveaway Shelf. VESA 100x100, DP+HDMI, tiny scuff on bottom bezel but no dead pixels. Can be picked up today after 3pm. Pic: https://imgur.com/abc123
Jordan: omg yes please. Do you know if it has speakers?
Miriam: No built-in speakers, but there's a 3.5mm audio out. Also has DisplayPort + HDMI.
Vince: @Jordan I’ll take it if you don’t — can swing by at ~4:15.
Alisha: @Miriam can you confirm the scuff is only on the bezel? also would you ship to remote for $20 (buyer covers postage/label)?
Miriam: scuff is cosmetic on bezel only, panel is fine. happy to ship for $20 if buyer sends label or covers postage.
OfficeBot: Reminder — please place items on the Giveaway Shelf with your name + date so Facilities can track.
Jordan: I can do pickup! @Vince sorry — first reply wins?
Vince: all good, Jordan. if you can’t make it LMK.
Jordan: I’ll grab it at 15:30. Thanks!!
Miriam: Awesome — marking claimed. Please DM me for details (stairs vs elevator access). :tada:
Alisha: Thanks for offering this — super generous! :raised_hands:
Jordan: also taking the lamp if that’s cool?
Miriam: lamp included. :thumbsup:
Jordan: added a quick calendar note: `Pickup: Monitor from Miriam` at 15:30 — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/xyz
Miriam: leaving it on the shelf now under my name. Whoever picks it up please sign the sheet.
Jordan: Got it — will sign. Thanks again!
Vince: if Jordan falls through I can do noon tomorrow.
Miriam: will update here if anything changes.
